vibe_rationale: Genuine tattoo scene, but a competition-led expo in a hotel venue with thin evidence, so it sits below the community-led peers.
fit_notes: Adult, tattooed, aftercare-conscious audience, so skin-recovery products have an obvious angle, and a hotel convention format makes a stall straightforward. Organiser, attendance and past editions are unknown, and partners so far are other conventions. Bali-based, so an Australian brand would need a local partner.
